scope: su/main/migration_inversion part 1 of 2. Inventory incomplete: only sugazmig is included; the other ten programs still require source review.

programs.name: sugazmig
programs.purpose: Migrate zero-offset traces using Gazdag phase shifts with an optional attenuation correction.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGAZMIGQ - SU version of Jeno GAZDAG's phase-shift migration

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: from first trace header dt in microseconds; 0.004 if zero

params.name: dx
params.default: computed: from first trace header d2; 1.0 if zero

params.name: Q
params.description: Quality factor used for attenuation correction.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable if set, otherwise empty string
params.description: Directory for named temporary files; an empty value uses tmpfile.

params.name: vfile
params.description: Binary float velocity file; when supplied, tmig and vmig are ignored.

params.name: tmig
params.description: Increasing times for interval velocities; read only when vfile is absent.

params.name: vmig
params.description: Interval velocities corresponding to tmig; read only when vfile is absent.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT results, complex frequency accumulation, interpolation, and pow, sqrt, sin, cos and exp can vary across implementations. The vfile branch allocates ntau velocities but reads nt floats, so ntau < nt can overflow and ntau > nt leaves values uninitialized. The nonzero ftau loop compares an integer index directly with the floating-point ftau and can access velocity samples outside the allocated range.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines multidimensional FFTs, frequency-by-frequency migration, interpolation, attenuation correction and temporary trace storage.

test_cases.description: Constant velocity and explicit input sampling.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sugazmig dt=0.004 dx=10 vmig=1500 Q=1000 ceil=100

test_cases.description: Time-varying velocity and a different output sampling interval.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sugazmig dt=0.004 dx=10 tmig=0,0.4 vmig=1500,2000 ntau=96 dtau=0.005 Q=500
